newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nichiei shares slump on earnings outlook.
newsitem.headline: Nichiei shares slump on earnings outlook.

text.p: Nichiei Co Ltd slumped on Thursday afternoon as investors sold the shares after its earnings forecast revealed profits which were well-within expectations, brokers said.

As of 0435 GMT, the shares of the leading firm in the credit guarantee business were down 900 yen or 8.04 percent at 10,300. It was the third-largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
On Wednesday, Nichiei said its parent current profit was forecast to rise to 51.50 billion yen in 1997/98, ending next March 31, from 46.61 billion yen in the previous year.
